Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding student fees, charges, and assessments.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to student fees, charges, and assessments; andadding a new section to chapter 28B.15 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.15 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any measure presented to a student body and passed with amajority vote of the students voting to create or increase a fee,charge, or assessment upon themselves is not subject to RCW 43.135.055and use of those fees is not subject to RCW 42.17.190. (2) Services and activities fees may be used for lobbying by astudent government association or its equivalent and may also be usedto support a statewide or national student organization or itsequivalent that may engage in lobbying.
